dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity white spots lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the posterior-lateral region and lower ventral-lateral fringe.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-lateral region form an obtuse triangular spatial relationship, with a series of smaller high-intensity blobs forming a semi-linear track towards the posterior dorsal curve.
